forbids: a declared sensitivity with no basis, and a basis the read surface drops
note: BL-216 R-3. Sensitivity is free text with no scale, deliberately — the organisation's own classification is the answer and this skill does not write one. Free text with no basis is an adjective on a record an assessor is entitled to follow, so the basis is what makes it a determination. Both halves are needed and the second is the one that would rot: an engine that refuses correctly while the renderer drops the basis satisfies the letter of the rule and none of its purpose. That is not hypothetical — render_context.py showed neither criticality nor sensitivity until v0.68.2, so a required-and-invisible field is the state this skill was actually in.

mutations.why: the refusal removed — a sensitivity reaching the store with no basis behind it
defeats: a sensitivity with no basis is refused

mutations.why: the basis dropped from the page — enforced on write, invisible on read, which is the half that decays into ceremony
defeats: the sensitivity and its basis both reach the rendered page
